retained_two_scope_statements_checked.topic: Unmarked card or Item Action eligibility
retained_two_scope_statements_checked.details: English p.12 permits unmarked effects in or out of Combat subject to requirements. FAQ Actions4 limits Basic Actions in Combat to fight/escape and forbids Room Actions. Candidate13 explicitly preserves these as separate limits, eliminating possible table-level generalization to unmarked Basic/Room Actions. Positive In Combat and Out of Combat rows still use presence/absence of an Intruder in the Character Room; Eggs remain excluded.

retained_two_scope_statements_checked.topic: Fire Weakness and Nest Egg pool
retained_two_scope_statements_checked.details: English p.25 retains the normal one-uncarried-Egg destruction during each Fire Damage step. FAQ Rooms7 expressly gives the two-Egg Vulnerability modifier for the Nest pool represented on the Intruder board. Candidate13 now states that exact narrower scope, without asserting a wider interaction for loose Eggs. FAQ Rooms9 distinction between loose Objects and Nest hit points is preserved. No new Noise roll is assigned to passive Event Fire.

retained_clarity_claims_checked.details: Normal Actions stop after passing; Interruption exception remains subject to usual requirements. Pass-time hand discard and own passing-round Fire timing remain. Empty-hand delayed pass and same-Room Interruption restriction still stated separately.

retained_clarity_claims_checked.topic: Room Action prerequisites and remote exceptions
retained_clarity_claims_checked.details: Cost2, presence, out of Combat and no Room Malfunction grouped near both descriptions. Explicit special-ability location exceptions retained; Scientist research still requires Object in Laboratory. Passive Cabins/Slime features remain marked passive/no Action, and Action/Item Engine Repair/Break retains its own Malfunction exception.

Silence/Danger Exploration results replace the movement Noise roll rather than adding another roll. Ordinary empty/occupied rule and other Exploration resolution retained. Careful Movement/Reconnaissance overrides remain explicit and supersede automatic Silence/Danger. Slime entry ordering and special Rooms unchanged.

retained_clarity_claims_checked.topic: Per-row selected Item cost and consumption
retained_clarity_claims_checked.details: Seven table Items each retain cost1, One Use Only and discard after effect: Bandages, Clothes, Fire Extinguisher, Taser, Energy Charge, Molotov and Nemesis Plans. Their actual Combat/target/OR effects remain. Medkit/Flashlight stay separate; no new one-use assumption is applied to Flashlight or reusable Weapons/Quest Items.

Each attack Injury one Egg; Grenade two; Molotov one immediate plus subsequent Fire; general Fire one per Fire Damage step, Nest Weakness two. Successful Egg Melee Contamination and missed waiver/timing gap preserved. Noise follows each Character attack attempt including misses, remote Grenade/Molotov in acting Room; passive Fire is separated from those attempts.
Card discard piles distinguished from marker-pool returns. Search/Storage bottom-deck exceptions, removed Contamination/Exploration, token reuse and standard-death Item removal all retained.

Previously disclosed overlap near Full Auto upper corner limits independent inspection of every hidden icon; no contrary rule was found and complete card procedures remain subject to card lookup.

source_limitations: The allowed manual/FAQ packet lacks the complete original Action, Item, Quest, Objective and Weakness card corpus. Full-core card-level completeness remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.

Selected tiny or overlapped illustrations cannot establish every hidden requirement. Candidate explicitly requires actual-card lookup; Grenade full normal procedure is not reconstructed from tiny artwork.
All eight Adults already in Combat leaves the English p.15 model-supply procedure unspecified.
Queen development adding an Egg after Nest destruction is not resolved by the supplied English rules/FAQ.
Normal Melee pre-roll Contamination draw versus Egg miss waiver lacks an explicit timing/refund procedure, even with PL/FR corroboration.
English first-death versus any-death Pod unlock wording remains inconsistent; the candidate preserves that limitation.
The medical repair states permission to treat another Character, not a full targeting-distance ruling.
